title: Stable influence of a monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. On the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$, the monomial associated to $S$ is the product of the coordinates in $S$. Its stable influence at parameter $\\rho\\in\\mathbb R$ and coordinate $i$ equals $\\rho^{|S|-1}$ if $i\\in S$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the coordinates
